decisions.reason: Its earlier award signal and very strong fit with the firm's core organic yogurt business likely keep results at or above aspiration levels, so management would continue it.
Because it was presented as a flagship cheese extension and remains closely tied to core capabilities, management would give it continued support unless performance clearly fell below aspirations.

As a fairly undifferentiated adjacent cheese with no later positive signals, it is more likely to be judged below aspiration after several years and its resources redirected to stronger core lines or new development.
This mild soft-cheese extension still fits the established portfolio and can be tolerated with some organizational slack, though the lack of later visibility keeps withdrawal risk meaningful.
